title: Fitted Loading Platform End Ramp
description: Original 1.4 m nominal-pitch end ramp for the existing 0.38 m loading platform. Metres, Z up, ground datum origin, uphill +X and rear curb +Y. Place the unchanged transport-short-platform-01 at (+1.4,0,0), no rotation. A low tapered toe and inclined cream deck rise to an upper landing; two grounded seafoam supports carry the deck and a honey rear curb follows the slope. The 25 mm high-end tongue fits the actual platform deck bevel; a 15 mm curb tongue meets its rear-curb bevel. The 1.425 m full X envelope includes the tongue and is not the nominal pitch. Full depth is 1.2 m. Static visual connector only; no accessibility, driving, collision, navigation, load, installation, safety or engineering certification. Not compatible with 2 m pavement modules or the 0.12/0.72 m launch ramp. No external model is embedded in this asset.
